photo.title: Pagoda roofed buildings in a temple complex. Small group of people gathered in the foreground.
View of a path running though a wooded valley.
Pagodas and temple complex with image of Bhairav to one side.

Street scene. A building with construction being done on it and a gateway in the distance. Three storey white building with stone lions outside on the right. The photo has been taken up against a building on the left so that only its beams and roof can be seen.
Street scene. Various two and three storey buildings in the foreground and a pagoda-like building behind them.
View down a dark, fairly narrow street. People walking with backs to the camera.
View down a busy street with a number of people in the foreground and two/three storey buildings to either side.
Street with a stone archway at the end of it. This may be the entrance to Bhktaper - one of three royal cities.
View of a rocky valley. A path can be seen on the left passing around a tree.
Village at the bottom of a valley, a man stands in the centre of the road holding a lamp in one hand and a stick in the other.
A raised path running into a wood. A building can be seen in the left corner.
A building with a pagoda like roof. A small wall runs in front of it, around which a number of people are standing.
Durbar square with large pagoda in the centre and people standing around.
View of 18th century Pagoda, stairs flanked by figures from Indian mythology, arranged in hierarchical power structure.
Street of thatched houses with children running down the road.
View of Durbar square. In the foreground is the Shiva Parvati temple with stone lions on the steps. In the distance buildings with pagoda roofs can be seen.
Street scene outside Nyatpola temple (which can be seen on the left)
Gathering of people in Taumadi Square.
Path with people three people sitting to the side of it. Two are holding sticks.
A river/stream flowing at a right angle into a straight channel - possibly an irrigation ditch. Hills in the bakground.
Rocky land at bottom of a valley with a path running along it. On the hillsides are buildings and stepped fields.
Settlement by a river and a road. Stepped fields behind it.
Fields enclosed with stone walls next to a river. Buildings can be seen in the background.
Tourist view in centre of Kathmandu
Three women involved in spinning and weaving in the open air.
Group of three brass workers.
On southern route from Mukli to Central Valley (? Sanghutar just across Likhu Khola)
A crowd of people standing in a square. Some are on horseback and many wear what look like khaki uniforms. Various buildings can be seen behind them.
View down a street with three storey buildings. People to either side.
Large ornate carving of Bhairav with stone lions to either side of steps.
Kasthamandap, the oldest building in Kathmandu. It has pagoda like architecture and is three storeys high. In the foreground a stone statue of a deity can be seen.
View down a street, two storey buildings to either side of the road.
Street with large ornately carved shrine and animals in the foreground.
View of a settlement situated in a rocky valley.
A shallow rocky river. Buildings can be seen on the hillside in the background. A number of sticks have been placed in the river to make a small dam in the foreground.
A small settlement on a stony land at the bottom of a shallow valley. One of the buildings only has a timber framework.
View down through a settlement. A cow in the foreground people carrying loads on their backs walking away from camera.
Road running through a valley with a settement at the bottom.
